description: This Dart source file defines common reusable Flutter widgets for a UI, including a CardShell container with loading placeholder functionality and an EmptyState message widget.

classes.name: CardShell
classes.description: A reusable surfaced card container with customizable content, optional icon, title, action, and loading state indicator.

classes.name: _LoadingBar
classes.description: A private widget representing a loading placeholder bar used within CardShell.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget displaying a message indicating an empty state, with optional compact display mode.

methods.name: CardShell.loadingOrChild
methods.description: Returns either a loading placeholder with shimmer effect or the provided child widget based on isLoading.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for CardShell widget, constructs the card UI with optional icon, title, action, and child content.

methods.name: _LoadingBar.build
methods.description: Build method for the _LoadingBar widget, renders a simple colored bar with specified width factor.

methods.name: EmptyState.build
methods.description: Build method for EmptyState widget, renders an icon and message, with a compact or full layout.
